board_name: Gaias Secret Agents protecting the Earth
title: 12 Screen-Free Ocean Activities for Kids Ages 6–11
description: Turn a beach trip or an afternoon at home into an ocean investigation. Explore 12 low-prep activities including a rock-pool census, tide-line detective mission, shorebird watch, wave patterns and more. Free screen-free ideas for parents, teachers and curious young Earth Protectors.
alt_text: Children and a grown-up respectfully exploring a coastal rock pool near the ocean, illustrating screen-free ocean activities for kids ages 6 to 11.
